seo.title: About Ayla | ABailey Events
seo.description: Meet the WPIC certified wedding planner and coordinator behind ABailey Events, based in Cookstown and serving Simcoe Muskoka.

heading: The heart behind ABailey Events
portraitAlt: Ayla Bailey of ABailey Events styling a garden Bloom Bar
detailAlt: White and blush rose bouquet resting by a window
paragraphs: At ABailey Events we have a passion for beautiful details, thoughtful design, and creating unforgettable experiences. We specialize in wedding coordination, event planning, and Bloom Bar Services.

From bringing wedding visions to life to creating unique, interactive floral experiences for guests, we are dedicated to making every celebration personal and memorable. Through creativity, organization, and genuine care, we ensure that every event reflects our clients' unique style and vision.
At ABailey Events, we believe every celebration deserves to be special, and we are committed to making each moment unforgettable.
